subject: gk
question: Identify the correct statement in relation to ampere.

options.text: One ampere is constituted by the flow of one coulomb of charge per minute
One ampere is constituted by the flow of two coulomb of charge per second
One ampere is constituted by the flow of one coulomb of charge per second
One ampere is constituted by the flow of half coulomb of charge per second

solution:
The correct answer is __**One ampere is constituted by the flow of one coulomb of charge per second**__.
